unqualified: Source preservation does not prove the strict Runtime.submitSafeDestination normalized ops/frame/calls1048/0xd18/30/372, slotChecksum156B/48instructions/3calls or general310/20PCL gate.
Actual noinline frames/copies, row-sharing and performance remain for the parent actual gate; no producer-tail restoration or benefit is claimed.
